name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement imaginary-time evolution classicall
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement imaginary-time evolution classically (via scipy expm of -tau*H) to find the ground state of the 5-qubit transverse Ising model (J=1.46, h=1.03), and verify by overlapping the result with a Qiskit-exact eigenvector. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
